note: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py under the same id and was checked against all 105 measured route sequences (adversarial suite: real-route controls).

rules.description: nodes[0] is shell.header and the last node is shell.footer; neither appears elsewhere.
rules.knownLiveDeviation: Live hides/varies chrome on some pages (see README Known deviations); the clone and this repo render the standard shell everywhere.

rules.description: At most one HERO-category node per page. Templates with heroPolicy=required need exactly one of requiresOneOf.

exceptions.reason: hero-less templates (no measured route has a page opener section)

rules.description: A HERO node is the first node after shell.header; only NAVIGATION sections in the opener slot (catalog sub-header) may precede it.
Nodes follow the template slot order shell-top < opener < body < shell-bottom.
cta.banner is the last node before shell.footer.
Two CTA-category nodes should not be adjacent, keyed on (section, variant).

exceptions.reason: download page lists per-platform downloads then QR codes (measured /download)

rules.description: After faq.accordion only CTA-category nodes or the footer follow.
At most 3 auto-advancing motion patterns (video-segment-tabs, auto-advance-tabs, logo-marquee) per page.
Every node's section is in the declared template's node list, with a variant observed for that template.
Every required template node is present.
A (section, variant) pair repeats only when the template node is repeatable; a section never exceeds its maxPerPage.
Reference-mode route must be one of the template routes (dynamic :params match any segment); generated routes are relative paths.
Sections with constraints.homeRouteOnly only appear on route "/" in reference mode / template.home in generated mode.
